title: Daughter Stole My $150K, Bought A Condo. So I Watched Her Scrub Toilets In 'Flushed My Trust'.
description: After a stroke, my daughter forged my signature and drained my $150K settlement to buy herself a beach condo. A hidden Ring doorbell video exposed her scheme, I won the condo plus damages in court, and now she cleans it every day in a shirt that reads 'Flushed My Trust' while every booking prints her fraud judgment. #StrokeOfBetrayal #KarmaClean #RevengeStory
thumb_text: MY DAUGHTER CLEANS MY CONDO IN 'FLUSHED MY TRUST'.
pinned_comment: If your own daughter forged your signature and stole $150K to buy a condo, would you have made her wear a 'Flushed My Trust' shirt too, or would you have handled it differently? I'd love to hear your take in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: SHE TOLD HUSBAND STROKE FRIED MOM'S BRAIN, BANK WON'T QUESTION IT
